info.name: BloodBridge Backend API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the BloodBridge backend (Express + MongoDB).

## How to use
1. Start the backend: `cd Backend && npm run dev` (default `http://localhost:5000`)
2. Run the login request of your role first — the token is auto-saved into collection variables:
   - `POST /api/auth/login` → saves `{{token}}` (User / Organization users)
   - `POST /api/admin/auth/login` → saves `{{adminToken}}`
   - `POST /api/superadmin/auth/login` → saves `{{superAdminToken}}`
3. Replace sample ids (`{{hospitalId}}`, `{{campId}}`, ...) with real ids from your database.

Folders follow the route files inside `Backend/routes/`.

item.name: 01 Health & Public
item.description: Server health, root and public endpoints defined directly in `Backend/app.js`.

request.description:
Organization user: send `organizationCode` + email + password.
Regular user: send only email + password.

item.name: 16 Organization Users
item.description: `routes/organization/OrganizationUsersRoutes.js` → `/api/organization-users`. Login as an organization ADMIN first (saves `{{token}}`).

item.name: 20 NGO - Camps, Slots & Registrations
item.description: `routes/ngo/NgoRoutes.js` → `/api/ngo` (Bearer `{{token}}`). Login as NGO ADMIN (camp CRUD) or `user` (registrations).
